note: MOCK. Transcribed by eye from website-handoff/screens/home-dashboard-dark.webp and hand-history-dark.webp, which were captured from the Dev build's 'regular' sample profile (scripts/screen.sh -PreflopProfile regular -PreflopStatus lifetime). These are sample-user numbers, not real users, but the SHAPE and labels are exactly what the UI shows. The Statistics screen has no current capture (only the outdated 2026-09-19 one), so its shape is given from code labels, not numbers: sections 'Where the hands go' (rows: '<seat> · <situation> · <hand type>', '4 of 5 hands wrong · ~21.9 bb/100 vs chart', accuracy pill) and 'What you keep doing' (e.g. 'You 3-bet too much at HJ', '40% of the time facing an open, where the charts 3-bet 29%. 20 hands.').
profile_free_vs_pro_note: A free Profile shows the session score, not overall accuracy (docs/STATUS.md).
paywall_screen_note: The captured paywall (screens/paywall-SUPERSEDED-dark.webp) shows Monthly + Annual with a trial. That is OLD. Live paywall: Monthly $7.99 and Lifetime $59.99 (preselected), no trial.
